meta_description: Why Guests Love This Home• Private pool + spa — rare in Seaside Proper• 60 yards to Tupelo Street Pavilion private beach access• Designer interiors and high-end furnishings• Rooftop sitting area with Gulf views• Elevator• Complimentary 4 bikes to explore 30A• Multiple liv
description_expanded: Why Guests Love This Home• Private pool + spa — rare in Seaside Proper• 60 yards to Tupelo Street Pavilion private beach access• Designer interiors and high-end furnishings• Rooftop sitting area with Gulf views• Elevator• Complimentary 4 bikes to explore 30A• Multiple living spaces—ideal for groups• Professionally managed with 24/7 support• Snowbird-friendly (Jan–Feb monthly stays)• Minimum age to book: 25________________________________________About This SpaceWelcome to Sea La Vie — Main House, a luxury coastal retreat nestled in the heart of Seaside Proper. Just steps from the Gulf, this elegant home blends upscale comfort with classic Seaside charm.Enjoy a private pool with attached spa, multiple indoor and outdoor living spaces, a chef’s kitchen, and a rooftop deck perfect for sunset lounging. Designer décor, curated furnishings, and thoughtful touches throughout make this home ideal for families and groups seeking an elevated beach getaway.Walk to Seaside Square for shopping and dining, or head straight to your private beach access only 60 yards from the front door.Need more space? This luxury residence can be booked together with Sea La Vie Seaside Carriage House, creating an exceptional Seaside estate ideal for extended families or groups. Please contact us for more info. For guests booking the main house only, please be aware that there may be guests also renting the detached carriage house at the back of the property.________________________________________The SpaceMain House (4BR • 4.5BA)First Floor• Bedroom 1: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds• Bedroom 2: King BedSecond Floor• Primary Suite: King Bed• Bedroom 3: King BedMain House Highlights• Three separate living areas—plenty of room for groups• Fully equipped chef’s kitchen with premium appliances• Multiple balconies + outdoor seating areas• Designer furnishings and coastal decor• Elevator for added convenience• Rooftop deck with Gulf views________________________________________Guest AccessGuests have private access to:• Entire Main House• Private pool and spa• Rooftop deck• Complimentary 4 bikes to explore 30A• All exterior spaces• Driveway parkingBeach access at the Tupelo Street Pavilion is included and located just 60 yards away.________________________________________Other Things to Note• Minimum age to book is 25• Optional pool heat: $75/night• Snowbird rentals available January–February (monthly only)• Monthly stays incur an additional $150 cleaning fee• Seaside Proper community rules and quiet hours apply________________________________________The NeighborhoodSea La Vie is located in Seaside Proper, one of the most iconic communities along Scenic 30A—known for its pastel cottages, walkable streets, charming shops, and Gulf-front pavilions.You’re a short walk from:• Seaside Square restaurants, boutiques, and events• Food trucks and local coffee spots• WaterColor + Grayton Beach• The 30A bike path• Paddleboarding, kayaking, fishing, golf, and nature trails• Snorkeling at the Sea Turtle Reef near Grayton Beach State Park Read less
